pages.text: Elytras are a heavily used transportation method, offering not only the ability to glide but to even fly through the use of certain items. Ophanim Wings are created by imbuing an Elytra with a Blood Feather and some Organic matter, and are ideal for gliding endlessly, without hurting the durability. In return, they don't resist to a sudden increase of velocity; losing a considerable amount of their
durability whenever a firework rocket is used. A Trident with Riptide will also lightly damage the Ophanim Wings. They can be repaired using Blood Feathers.
